from transformers import AutoModelForSequenceClassification, AutoTokenizer
import torch, json

# Load merged model from disk
model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained('/app/merged_model/')
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('/app/merged_model/')

model.eval()
test_samples = [
    'Bonjour, comment allez-vous aujourd\'hui?',
    'Hola, ¿cómo estás hoy?',
    'Guten Tag, wie geht es Ihnen?',
    'Ciao, come stai oggi?',
    'Olá, como você está?',
    'Привет, как дела?',
    'こんにちは、お元気ですか？',
    '你好，你好吗？',
    'مرحبا، كيف حالك؟',
    'Hello, how are you?',
]

with torch.no_grad():
    for text in test_samples:
        inputs = tokenizer(text, return_tensors='pt', truncation=True, max_length=512)
        outputs = model(**inputs)
        probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=-1)
        conf, pred = torch.max(probs, dim=-1)
        print(f'  {pred.item()} ({conf.item():.4f}) -> {text[:40]}...')

# Verify config
import json as j
with open('/app/merged_model/config.json') as f:
    cfg = j.load(f)
print(f'num_labels: {cfg[\"num_labels\"]}')
print(f'model_type: {cfg[\"model_type\"]}')
" 2>&1

from transformers import AutoModelForSequenceClassification, AutoTokenizer
import torch, json

model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained('/app/merged_model/')
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('/app/merged_model/')

with open('/app/merged_model/config.json') as f:
    cfg = json.load(f)
print(f'num_labels: {cfg[\"num_labels\"]}')
print(f'architectures: {cfg[\"architectures\"]}')

model.eval()
test_samples = [
    'Bonjour, comment allez-vous aujourd\'hui?',
    'Hola, ¿cómo estás hoy?',
    'Guten Tag, wie geht es Ihnen?',
    'Ciao, come stai oggi?',
    'Olá, como você está?',
    'Привет, как дела?',
    'こんにちは、お元気ですか？',
    '你好，你好吗？',
    'مرحبا، كيف حالك؟',
    'Hello, how are you?',
]

with torch.no_grad():
    for text in test_samples:
        inputs = tokenizer(text, return_tensors='pt', truncation=True, max_length=512)
        outputs = model(**inputs)
        probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=-1)
        conf, pred = torch.max(probs, dim=-1)
        print(f'  class {pred.item()} ({conf.item():.4f}) -> {text[:45]}...')

# Verify results file
with open('/app/detection_results.json') as f:
    results = json.load(f)
print(f'\nResults file has {len(results)} entries')
for r in results:
    print(f'  {r[\"predicted_class_id\"]} ({r[\"confidence\"]}) -> {r[\"text\"][:40]}...')
" 2>&1
